decision_reason: The running process environment and kkFileView trust warning reproducibly show that the local startup fallback collapses two different network endpoints into 127.0.0.1.

causal_assessment.hypothesis: backend-dev.sh rewrites MINIO_ENDPOINT for host reachability without retaining the original Docker-reachable endpoint for MINIO_PREVIEW_ENDPOINT.
supporting_evidence: before correction the Java process had MINIO_ENDPOINT and MINIO_PREVIEW_ENDPOINT both set to http://127.0.0.1:9000
kkFileView rejects 127.0.0.1 but reaches host.docker.internal:9000 from its container
KkFileViewUrlBuilder already supports re-signing with MINIO_PREVIEW_ENDPOINT
causal_assessment.falsifier: a restarted backend preserves a trusted container-reachable preview endpoint without changing backend MinIO reachability

invariants: host backend continues to reach MinIO through 127.0.0.1
kkFileView continues to be browser-accessible through 127.0.0.1:8012
an explicitly configured non-loopback preview endpoint is preserved
control_action.rollback: restore the prior backend-dev.sh fallback and restart the local backend
correction_check: backend, kkFileView and container-to-MinIO health probes

residual_risk: authenticated browser preview remains an operator recheck if no local login session is available
